ESPGHAN (European Society for Pediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition) is an international professional medical association. In the context of Danish healthcare quality assurance, ESPGHAN is significant for its role in shaping clinical standards for the diagnosis and management of Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) in pediatric patients [^src1].

ESPGHAN's forthcoming pediatric IBD guidelines, expected to be released in 2025, will directly influence the evidence-based adjustment of "Indicator 1b" in Danish clinical practice [^src1]. Indicator 1b is a central quality metric used to evaluate the diagnostic workup for IBD in children and adolescents, specifically tracking compliance with procedures like small bowel MRI scans and analyzing regional variations in care [^src1]. The broader national effort to standardize and improve IBD diagnostics in Denmark—monitored through the DANIBD database—relies on upcoming guidance from international societies like ESPGHAN, alongside national bodies, to refine these quality indicators and improve patient outcomes [^src1].
